name: Leg Extension
primary_muscles: quadriceps (rectus femoris, vastus lateralis, vastus medialis, vastus intermedius)
common_faults: not reaching full knee extension at the top
excessive ROM at the bottom creating unnecessary joint stress

substitutions.note: compound; adds hip drive; lower anterior knee shear
compound squat; full quad stimulus with hip involvement

resistance_profile: hardest at full extension where tibia is most perpendicular to resistance; anterior shear force peaks in mid-range

provenance.notes: Anterior shear force on the knee is highest in the mid-range; use with caution in knee-sensitive populations. Some protocols restrict to terminal 30° ROM. Good VMO isolation when feet slightly internally rotated.
